title: HCLS AI Factory: an open precision-medicine platform
description:
An Apache-2.0 precision-medicine platform: eight compute engines, eight clinical intelligence agents, and the Tuberous Sclerosis Complex disease program, running end to end on a single NVIDIA DGX Spark.

Engines: Genomic Foundation (GPU variant calling), Precision Intelligence (annotation and clinical RAG), Therapeutic Discovery (generation, docking, ADMET), Clinical Imaging, Precision Oncology, Cardiology, Single-Cell, and Structural Biology. Agents: CAR-T, Precision Biomarker, Pharmacogenomics, Precision Autoimmune, Neurology, Rare Disease, Single-Cell, and Clinical Trial — clinical decision support grounded in retrieved evidence, with citations.

Governance includes a clinical-overclaim honesty gate, a typed capability registry in which a live capability can never be mock-served, and a 21 CFR Part 11 reproducibility manifest. Decision support for a qualified clinician — never autonomous diagnosis.

The code is Apache-2.0. Third-party datasets are read rather than redistributed and carry their own terms, several of them non-commercial; see DATA_LICENSES.md.
